text:
elena: Quick heads-up — Hosted Dispatch v1.2 + ToolCall v2 are rolling to GA on hosted API :tada:. This release focuses on lower tail latency for tool calls, improved streaming semantics, and a safer migration path from toolcall-v1.
elena: TL;DR: internal canary today, public canary (opt-in keys) in ~48h, full GA in two weeks. SDKs + OpenAPI spec published. Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosted/dispatch-v1-2-toolcall-v2

matt: awesome. high level: does this change request/response format for tool calls? will older clients break?

elena: good q — toolcall v2 is backward-compatible at the HTTP layer for 95% of usages. the main differences:
- streaming tool responses can arrive as partial chunks with event tags (improved UX for long-running tools)
- an explicit tool-session-id is optional but recommended for caching/routing
- new error codes for transient tool throttling (451/452)

we'll keep toolcall-v1 supported for 90 days post-GA with automated fallback behavior for hosted customers. migration guide in the docs has examples.

sara: ops question — any rate-limit or quota changes we should flag to customers?

elena: no baseline quota changes. we added a per-tool concurrent limit default (configurable per-customer) to avoid noisy neighbors. will surface in console and via billing API.

chad: eng-sre notes: rollout plan? signal flags we should watch?

elena: plan:
- today: internal canary (eng + seats) — tag: dispatch-v1.2-canary
- +48h: public opt-in canary keys (customers can opt in via console)
- +7 days: gradual ramp to 50% traffic for eligible keys
- +14 days: GA switch for hosted (opt-out available for enterprise accounts)

please watch these metrics during canary: tail p95/p99 latency for tool calls, tool error-rate (>= 5xx + 451/452), streaming chunk completeness, and cost per 1k tokens.

ops-bot: deploys: dispatch:v1.2-canary -> cluster-west-3 @ 2412345800, dispatch:v1.2-canary -> cluster-east-2 @ 2412345850

matt: will SDKs handle streaming changes automatically? is this a breaking SDK bump?

devex-bot: SDK release notes: js-sdk v3.2.0 adds streaming-tool events and helper for tool-session-id. python-sdk v1.9.0 mirrors features. examples and migration snippets in repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/tree/main/dispatch-examples

nina: legal/compliance check — any PII telemetry differences?

elena: no new data collection. we added an opt-in telemetry flag for more granular tool-level metrics (disabled by default). audit logs will include tool-session-id when present. KMS/HSM policies unchanged.

sara: customer comms: PR draft? KB + migration checklist?

elena: yes — marketing + product drafted a KB and email templates. will post PR to #announcements-assets in ~2h. short customer-facing bullets: migration timeline, canary opt-in, SDK links, contact support for enterprise opt-out.

chad: if canary shows elevated 5xxs, what's rollback plan?

elena: automated rollback to dispatch-v1.1 with zero-downtime routing; SRE runbook: run the rollback playbook, invalidate canary keys, notify customers. I'll ping eng-sre leads immediately when we hit threshold.

matt: any impact to Dedicated / Private customers?

elena: Dedicated/private are unaffected by hosted GA. we will publish a self-hosted package in 3–4 weeks with the same feature set if customers want to pick it up.

sara: small ask — can we add a short curl example for streaming tool calls in the KB? some customers still like cURL snippets.

elena: done — here's the snippet for the announcement thread:```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"dispatch-v1.2","tool_calls": [{"name":"lookup","input":"..."}], "stream": true}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dispatch
```

matt: thanks — will add to release notes. :thumbsup:

nina: approving customer comms from compliance side. small edit to KB re: telemetry opt-in language.

elena: will update. thanks everyone — I'll post the canary opt-in link when public keys are ready. ping me @elena for emergencies. :rocket:

sara: :tada: congrats team — nice work!

chad: watching dashboards. good luck.

ops-bot: reminder: incident channel #eng-oncall subscribed. automated alerts enabled for dispatch-v1.2-canary.

devex-bot: published docs snapshot: https://docs-snapshots.redwood.ai/dispatch/v1.2 (internal)
